    User-facing desktop configuration: taskbar thickness, position, icon size, the Swing application UI font, and the taskbar auto-hide toggle.

    Where the taskbar is docked.

    The desktop's file-type -> application associations: which application opens which kind of file (for example, the PDF Viewer opens .pdf).

    A file type the "Default Applications" panel offers out of the box.
    HolidayRegions
    The single source of truth for turning a configured holiday-region token into a statutory-holiday list, shared by every surface that marks holidays: the 2D taskbar clock's calendar popup (via HolidayCalendar) and the orgchart AgendaGrid.

    A helper class that simplifies preference usage by LG3D apps by implementing LG3D's conventions regarding the default initial preferences settings.
